messages:
maddie_support: Escalation from Delphia — intermittent cross-region routing and major latency spikes. They say requests intermittently land in eu-west even though their SDK sets X-Region: us-west. Also seeing billing records charged against the EU tenant. Request ids: req_01F8Z9A, req_01F8ZB3, req_01F8ZC7. Attaching sample curl they provided below.

delphia_integration: reproducer (sanitized):
curl -v https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/chat -H 'Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJI... (token from our test org)' -H 'X-Region: us-west' -d '{"input":"hey"}'

maddie_support: Their logs show server route chosen: eu-west, avg latency ~420ms for those req ids. Billing events show eu tenant IDs. They claim this started after onboarding (tokens issued by our auth service).

sam_engineer: Can you paste the full Authorization header (no keys) — I want the JWT decoded payload. If we have a region claim in the JWT it might be taking precedence.

maddie_support: pasted decoded payload (redacted):
{
  "sub": "user:delphia-service",
  "org": "delphia-prod-eu",
  "region": "eu-west",
  "iat": 1765439000
}

sam_engineer: Ah — the token contains a region claim set to eu-west. Our router currently evaluates token claims for routing if present. In theory header should override token, but looks like we have precedence reversed in the routing policy for authenticated requests.

lee_oncall: Severity? Customer seeing latency + billing misattribution. I'd mark P1 for oncall.

maddie_support: Customer impact: production traffic degraded, customers reporting slow search features. Billing wrong orgs -> finance escalation. They want a hotfix or a mitigation ASAP.

sam_engineer: Quick repro steps I ran in staging (confirmed):
1) mint JWT with region claim: eyJ...payload..{"region":"eu-west"} (signed by test key)
2) curl with header X-Region: us-west and that JWT
3) router logs show: route_decision=token_region (eu-west) -> selected_pool=eu-1 -> response from eu node

Example router log (staging):
[2026-03-15T18:12:05Z] req=req_abc route_decision=token_region token_region=eu-west header_region=us-west selected_pool=eu-1

router-bot: automated note: routing_policy=v2.3 currently resolves region by: 1) token claim 2) header X-Region 3) query param. A config flip exists but not active in production.

sam_engineer: We should change policy so explicit request header wins over token claim for routing. Token region should be used only when header/query absent. That mirrors our docs. Looks like a config drift during the last rollout.

lee_oncall: Temporary mitigation for the customer: remove region claim from tokens issued to their service (short term) or set header X-Region explicitly in every request and add a tag in gateway to prefer header if present (we can enable a feature flag in the edge). Which is faster?

sam_engineer: Fastest is to flip the feature flag at the edge to prefer header. I can push a toggle to the staging edge and then to canary prod within 30 minutes, then full rollout. Also prepare a patch to routing code to ensure tests assert header precedence.

maddie_support: I notified Delphia: suggested mitigation (remove region claim from token or set header) and that we're rolling a config change. They prefer us to flip feature flag.

delphia_integration: Confirmed — we can rotate tokens if needed but would rather wait for your toggle. Impact window is ~2 hours for some endpoints.

sam_engineer: Plan: (1) enable header-precedence feature flag on canary edge (5% of traffic) -> monitor route logs and billing tags for 30 mins (2) if green, roll to 100% (3) ship unit/integration test to prevent regression. I'll post rollout IDs here.

lee_oncall: Assigning oncall runbook steps: notify finance to expect some billing reclassification, open short-lived invoice hold if necessary.

sam_engineer: Rollout started: rollout_id=roll-2026-0315-01 canary=5%

router-bot: rollout update: roll-2026-0315-01 canary ok after 25m. metrics: cross-region-routes down 92% for canary, no error increase.

maddie_support: Communicated to Delphia: canary looks good, will continue to full rollout. They appreciate the fast response.

sam_engineer: Full rollout complete: roll-2026-0315-01 -> 100%. Added regression test to CI. Creating followup ticket to audit tokens issued by our auth service to ensure region claims are only used for legacy tenants.

maddie_support: Closing the escalation after confirming Delphia sees consistent us-west routing and billing reclassified. Will follow up on token audit. :white_check_mark:

lee_oncall: Postmortem note: root cause = config drift where routing policy precedence was unintentionally changed in v2.3 rollout. Mitigation = feature-flagged fix and test coverage. Action items: token-audit, config gating for routing policy changes, add a warning in our onboarding docs about tokens with region claim.

maddie_support: Thanks team. If Delphia sees any more anomalies they will reopen thread.
